extension.summary: Scrobble plays to your Scrob instance
extension.description: Automatically tracks movies and TV shows in your self-hosted Scrob instance as you watch them in Kodi.
extension.news:
1.1.3 - Fix episodes and movies not marked as watched after resume-from-stop
1.1.2 - Fix scrobbling not working for TV episodes (switch to JSON-RPC Player.GetItem)
1.1.1 - Fix scrobbling not working for TV episodes (retry reading metadata after OnPlay)
1.1.0 - Sync settings: toggle scrobbling to Scrob and library sync from Scrob on startup - Rate movies and/or episodes after watching via a 1-10 star popup (optional, default off)
1.0.0 - Initial release
